chose: Keep the structure reading current across the adoption hand-off: the session's Stop starts one reading of the tree it leaves in the background (detached, one at a time, a live reading of an older tree superseded after checking its command line is a structure query, never twice for one tree; SubagentStop starts none); SessionStart, finding the reading stale, waits at most 15 s for a refresh of this very tree only when the last reading's recorded duration says it finishes within that; otherwise orient names the gaps as the last reading had them, derived with the current spec and runs, less every gap the current spec visibly closes (guard:, control: none, trusted trust:, entrance removed), labeled 'as of the reading before the latest changes, taken <time> UTC; a new one is under way'; with no reading ever kept, one line says the gaps are not read yet and that scaffold control --all reads them now, never a count
over: refresh at Stop alone, which a session starting seconds later never sees (a reading took 190-280 s on the A/B beds) | silence on a stale reading, which hid the line from every session after an adoption | an unbounded or always-on wait at SessionStart, which would spend the 60 s hook timeout on readings that take minutes | silence when no reading was ever kept | refreshing at SubagentStop, whose session is still editing
because: an adopting session ends by committing spec changes, so the next SessionStart always found the reading stale and orient said nothing (df-84db9e4f); the component interfaces the reading holds change slowly while the spec is read now, so the last reading with the current spec names what is still open and never a gap the spec answers, and the label says what it is; the stop is where the tree the next session starts on is final. Verified on copies of the A/B beds: back to back, stl.quest (its adoption baseline retracted in the copy, since the adopting session had baselined both gaps, which alone kept orient silent there) and praetorium.gg (robots waiver removed) showed the labeled line at SessionStart in 1.7 s and 3.1 s; after the refresh finished (190-280 s) the line came unlabeled; a start 185 s after Stop waited about 3 s and showed it fresh; with no reading, the pointer
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
